building_history.method: Required: identify intersecting temporal rasters, sum native building_fractional_count within the village polygon for each annual inference date, handle nodata and overlapping tile coverage, and retain raster provenance. Not executed.
building_history.reason: Public anonymous Google Cloud Storage access was verified, but no village raster aggregation was completed. A temporary rasterio installation failed with OSError [Errno 28] No space left on device. No dated counts are available locally; this is an acquisition/processing gap, not a zero-growth finding.

limitations: The image is a 2024 annual mosaic, not a single dated acquisition or current survey.
Nominal 10 m imagery cannot reliably enumerate individual buildings or roof areas.
EOX 2024 imagery is included for noncommercial demonstration; commercial deployment requires an appropriate EOX license or replacement imagery.
Imagery provides geographical context, not measured electricity demand or cold-start model validation.
Buildings, households, customers and electricity connections are distinct quantities.
